executive_summary: Maven build failed with 45 compilation errors due to missing critical dependencies. The primary root cause is the absence of Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 dependencies in the pom.xml. These missing dependencies prevent the compilation of security configuration, repository interfaces, entity classes, and utility classes.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security packages for @EnableWebSecurity, HttpSecurity, and SecurityFilterChain, but these are not available in the classpath.

Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces (ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository) extend JpaRepository and use @Query, @Modifying, and @Param annotations which are not available without this dependency.

Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity classes like BoardColumn use JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column) which require jakarta.persistence packages. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml as it includes Jakarta Persistence API. If already added, verify the Spring Boot version is 3.x or higher which uses jakarta.persistence instead of javax.persistence.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. The ValidationUtils class uses StringUtils or other utilities from this library.
